# teamService

## Access

| Option             | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Row policy         | `anyOf`: the highest level of (`owner`: Admin for the user the `ownerId` column names), (`members`: the role in the user's `teamMember` row (`teamId` names the row, `userId` the user, `role` the role)) |
| Service-wide Admin | passes every check of the service                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Change topic       | `"authenticated"`: any signed-in caller                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Field levels       | `notes`: Admin                                                                                                                                                                                            |

Each method below says who may call it.

## Entity

| Field     | Type     | Level |
| --------- | -------- | ----- |
| `id`      | `string` |       |
| `name`    | `string` |       |
| `ownerId` | `string` |       |
| `notes`   | `string` | Admin |

A caller receives a field only with at least its level on the row.

## Methods

| ----- | -------- |
| `id`  | `string` |

### `profile`

Output: one row as the `entity` projection.

## Streams

Feeds of items the server appends, each subscriber starting from the latest few.

### `world`

| Option   | Value                      |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| Item     | `number`                   |
| Scope    | one feed per `worldId`     |
| Seed     | none (default)             |
| Volatile | no                         |
| Access   | `{ room: (scope) => ... }` |
| Checked  | always                     |

### `lobby`

| Option   | Value               |
| -------- | ------------------- |
| Item     | `string`            |
| Scope    | one global feed     |
| Seed     | the latest item     |
| Volatile | no                  |
| Access   | `{ room: "lobby" }` |
| Checked  | always              |

### `feed`

| Option   | Value                                            |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Item     | `string`                                         |
| Scope    | one feed per `teamId`                            |
| Seed     | computed by the service when a socket subscribes |
| Volatile | no                                               |
| Access   | `{ room: { prefix: "team:" } }`                  |
| Checked  | in development only (`validate: "development"`)  |

## Channels

Fire-and-forget messages from clients, dropped over the rate.

### `cursor`

| Option   | Value                                                       |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Payload  | `{ x: number }`                                             |
| Rate     | 30 a second per socket (default)                            |
| Burst    | 60 (default)                                                |
| Requires | the sending socket in the app room `lobby`                  |
| Access   | `{ service: "Read" }`: a service-wide grant of Read or more |
